assertion.statement: The actual local elliptic curve has the stated smooth Neron model, identity subgroup and finite geometric component group, and unramified base change preserves this model and geometric component group.
assertion.objects: Actual fixed local elliptic curves B/F in the Heegner descent argument, B0 and Phi_B over the geometric residue field.
assertion.hypotheses: F is a nonarchimedean characteristic-zero local field and Fprime/F is finite unramified; the local curves range over the stated finite fixed list.
assertion.quantifiers: Every such local curve and unramified extension, including even extension degrees.
assertion.parameter_range: All residue characteristics; arbitrary reduction type.
assertion.uniformity: For each fixed B, the same geometric c_B; take a common multiple for the finite fixed list.
assertion.constants: c_B=order of Phi_B(kbar); no asserted numerical estimate.
assertion.normalizations: B0(Fprime) means integral points of the Neron identity open subgroup.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Only this model or lifting input; no outgoing H1 annihilation or full geometry conclusion is used as a premise.
assertion.limit_order: Fix each local curve before forming c_B and varying the unramified extension.
